    Cookies are disabled in Chrome
    Google sign-in requires cookies to be enabled. Your Chrome has them blocked.

    To fix in Chrome:
    1. Tap the ⋮ menu → Settings
    2. Go to Privacy and security
    3. Tap Third-party cookies
    4. Select "Allow third-party cookies" or "Block third-party cookies in Incognito only"

    Or use email & password sign-in below — that works without cookies.
